info.name: RealityOS · Live jury evaluation
info.description: Import this collection, select No environment, open a scenario and click Send on any request. Existing server accounts, passwords, workspace IDs, record IDs, publication IDs and questions are included. Login and token renewal run automatically. All requests use the live RealityOS server and its existing stored data. The owner authorized public release of these three evaluation accounts on 2026-11-03. Their existing workspace roles are administrator. Session tokens and provider credentials are not published. Full API templates are available separately in RealityOS.reference.postman_collection.json.
